events.title: Proposed ruling: refund_partial $4.33 (model confidence 0.86)
events.body:
This is a RydeTAXI metered trip, so the fare varies with distance and the deviation rule bites on kilometres [F6][RD-2]. The trace settles that one off-route segment exists (09:24–09:30, 3.78 km driven where the optimal route covers 0.71 km) [F3][RD-1], and that no traffic incident on the replaced stretch was reported before the detour — only speed bands 5 (40–49 km/h) on the ECP and Airport Boulevard, which do not exempt anything [F11][F12][F13][RD-4].

The RD-5 question turns on the chat. The only two messages are the rider's 09:04 greeting at the Raffles Place taxi stand and the driver's 09:05 "2 min away" [F7][F8]; the record is complete and both are timestamped [F9]. Neither message gives any route authorisation, general or specific, before the segment began at 09:24. The driver's post-trip statement that "I went where the GPS sent me; it rerouted" is his own claim, written after the trip [F10], and a driver's statement alone is not rider consent [RD-5]. Nothing in the record ties the segment to any rider-named place either, so RD-3(a) cannot exempt it [F7][F8][RD-3]. The segment therefore counts as an unexcused deviation.

Amount: the trip's per-kilometre rate is the distance fare divided by the distance billed, $34.42 ÷ 24.41 km = $1.41008/km [F4][F6]. Applying that rate to the unexcused segment's extra km: 3.07 km × $1.41008/km = $4.329, rounded to cents = $4.33 [F3][F4][RD-2]. Only the mile-unit excess is refunded; the remaining +0.13 km of distance excess (3.20 km total vs the segment's 3.07 km) is not attributed to any segment and is not refunded [F1][F3][F4][RD-2]. The driver-profile field route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so no account flag arises [F16][RD-6].

Safety screen (SAFE-1): I read every chat message, the driver's statement and the complaint. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation; the driver's statement is a factual dispute about routing [F7][F8][F10], so safety_concern is none [SAFE-1].
